## Embedded frame

An embedded frame with no `tabindex`, which is tabbable by default.

```{=html}
<iframe id="fixture-frame" title="Embedded frame" srcdoc="<p>Frame content.</p>"></iframe>
```

## Focusable widget

A widget that is focusable only through `tabindex`.

```{=html}
<div id="fixture-widget" tabindex="0">A focusable widget.</div>
```
